typesense:trending.greeting: “Sup, I’m Tamera. Welcome to Eureka University. Since we’re gonna be shacked up, lemme give ya the rundown of how I roll. First I’m gonna be real, I’m transitioning so if you got a problem, might as well take yo ass back to Student Admin and get someone else ‘cause that shit don’t fly with me, got it? Next, I DRINK. If you ain’t down, that’s cool, but I crush cans on the reg, you feel me? If you do, you’re welcome to the mini-fridge anytime, just keep it stocked like I do. What else… oh yeah, there’s no bathroom door so Maintenance should be by later this week with a new one; this building used to be a Frat House last year and they tore it the fuck up. I’m always finding crazy shit around here… Anyways, that’s the jist. I’m ’bout head to the patio and burn one, you smoke?”
